text:
alex (AE): Quick sync — prepping the EdgeGuard POC kickoff tomorrow. Customer asked for two focused flows: 1) semantic support search + answer synthesis, 2) claim summarization with entity extraction. Need clear endpoints, minimal data requirements, success metrics, and a 4-week timeline. Can we scope this to an MVP?

rachael (SE): 4 weeks is tight but doable if we keep it narrow. Proposed endpoints: /v1/support/answer and /v1/claims/summarize. Start with quantized 7B for cost, fallback to 13B for low-confidence cases. Latency target: p95 < 800ms for short queries. Eval plan: 200 search queries (relevance + answer quality) and 300 claim examples (entity & summary). :+1:

devon (PM): Success criteria to include in SOW: support answer manual-rating precision >= 0.78, answer latency p95 < 800ms, claim summary ROUGE-L > 0.6 OR human accept rate >= 85%. Define rollback: if hallucination rate > 10% on eval set we pause tuning and revert prompts/models.

rachael (SE): Data reqs: ingestion for retrieval index = ~2k anonymized support docs (can start with 500 seed docs). For summarization/entity extraction we need ~500 labeled claims to get a reliable baseline. We'll supply an eval harness and sample prompts. Example summarization prompt (seed):

```
System: You are a precise insurance claims summarizer. Extract key entities (policy_id, claim_date, amount, claimant) and a 1-2 sentence summary.
User: "Claim text..."
Assistant: Provide JSON with entities + summary, keep values canonicalized.
```

alex (AE): Security asks from the buyer: VPC + SSO, retention policy <= 90 days, and no egress to third-party analytics. Pricing question: rough cost for a 4-week POC (hosted usage + small dedicated GPU)? Rachael, can you give a token and infra estimate so I can finalize the SOW?

rachael (SE): Quick estimate: support search + synthesis ~150k tokens/week, summaries ~50k tokens/week => ~800k tokens total over 4 weeks. With dedicated small GPU + caching and quantized 7B, estimated POC cost ~= $6k (this covers infra + ops + support hours). Will confirm after we size the retrieval index. Also note: request NDA addendum for customer dataset. :thinking:

devon (PM): Deliverables by week (suggested): Week 1: infra + ingestion + baseline run; Week 2: eval set + baseline metrics; Week 3: tuning + A/B with fallback; Week 4: final report, runbook, and handoff. If that looks good Alex can ship the SOW today.

ops-bot: staging cluster provisioned: staging-edgeguard-01. Vault creds + onboarding doc shared to #sales-vault (link hidden).
